info.title: Facio Kernel shared sandbox API
info.description: A shared sandbox with current account and tenant authorization, immutable configuration releases, configured insurance decisions, review, servicing and renewal. Registered synthetic document generation, financial evidence, provider simulation and internal loss notices remain bounded training capabilities. Activation does not certify customer acceptance, production insurance execution or external delivery.
